parts.passageHtml:
{[Tribal tourism is becoming more popular.][297891]} {[But at what cost to the locals?][297898]}

{[Tribal tourism is a relatively new type of tourism.][297907]} {[It involves travellers going to remote destinations, staying with local people and learning about their culture and way of life.][297916]} {[They stay in local accommodation, share facilities with local people, and join in with meals and celebrations.][297937]} {[At the moment, less than one percent of holidays are tribal tourism holidays, but this is set to change.][297955]}

{[Not everyone is convinced that tribal tourism is a good thing, and opinions are divided.][297976]} {[The argument is about whether or not it helps the local people, or whether it exploits them.][297991]} {[Because tribal tourism is relatively new, the long-term effects on local people have not been studied in much detail.][298007]} {[Where studies have been carried out, the effects have been found to be negative.][298027]}

{[Travel writer Ian Coleman recalls a recent trip to Guatemala, where he saw an example of this.][298043]} {['There is a village with a statue of a man called Maximon, who has a special spiritual meaning for the local tribe,' he explains.][298060]} {['The statue is kept indoors, and once a year the locals bring him out and carry him around the village.][298079]} {[However, visitors now pay money for them to bring the statue out and carry it around, while they take photographs.][298099]} {[As a result, Maximon has lost his original meaning, and is now just another tourist attraction'][298122]}

{[So, is it possible to experience an exotic culture without harming it in some way?][298139]} {['With a bit of thought, we can maximise the positive impacts and minimise the negative,' says travel company director Hilary Waterhouse.][298154]} {['Remember that you are there not only to experience a different culture, but to help it in some way.][298175]} {[Tourists bring money to the community, which the community can invest in local projects.][298194]} {[However, this does not mean you can act the way you might do back home.][298209]} {[The most important thing is to show respect, learn about, and be aware of local customs and traditions.][298225]} {[Always remember you're a guest. '][298244]}

Tribal tourism

People who take a tribal tourism holiday visit places that are 1 When they are there, they find out about the local 2 and how people live. Currently, tribal tourism accounts for less than 3 of the tourism industry. Tribal tourism holidays are different from foreign exchange visits because the travellers and the people they meet have different 4 Tribal tourism travellers experience a 5 that they are not familiar with. For them, this is its 6 However, some people argue that 7 do not benefit from this kind of tourism. 8 show that the effects of tribal tourism are not good.

questionSets.instructionHtml:
Questions 9 - 13:

Match each statement with the correct person, A-B-C-D.

NB You may use any letter more than once.

 List of people

A. Ian Coleman B. Hilary Waterhouse
C. Dawn Baker D. Jamie White

questions.text: Travellers may need to change the way they behave.
questions.explanationHtml:
However, this does not mean you can act the way you might do back home.
không thể nào hành xử như đang ở quê nhà của mình, phải "change the way they behave"

questions.text: Some travellers would not enjoy living the way that the local people do.
questions.explanationHtml:
Đoạn cuối (It's not for everyone, but for me was all part of the experience)

D (paraphrase ‘not for everyone’ = ‘Some travellers would not enjoy’)

questions.text: Tribal tourism can have benefits for local people
questions.explanationHtml: đoạn 5: Remember that you are there not only to experience a different culture, but to help it in some way. Tourists bring money to the community, which the community can invest in local projects.

questions.text: Some travellers make local people do things that they would not normally do.
Learning about a place before you go there makes your trip much more satisfying.
questions.explanationHtml: đoạn 6 ('The rewards of a trip to this country are priceless, and the more you know in advance, the more priceless they are.)
